notes: No genuine Bestsellers PLP exists on hipvan.com. Checked: robots.txt (no Claude-specific disallow; direct HTTP fetch used throughout, matching prior Home-Decor pass for this company) and the full sitemap (sitemaps/sitemap.xml -> collections.xml.gz [2528 collection URLs incl. paginated variants, ~910 unique base collections] and pages.xml.gz [47 CMS pages]) -- grep for best|popular|trend|favor|top-sell across all URLs returned zero hits. Direct URL probes all 404: /best-sellers, /bestsellers (301-redirects to /bestsellers-2 which itself 404s -- confirms a removed/retired page), /best-selling, /top-sellers, /top-selling-products, /popular, /popular-products, /most-popular, /customer-favorites, /trending. Site search (/search?q=bestseller) returned a generic results-page title with no real product grid. Homepage (https://www.hipvan.com/) has a marketing section literally named 'Shop Our Best Selling Collections' (data-tracking-section=shop_best_selling_collections) but every card in it links to an ORDINARY category PLP with a sort param, e.g. /sofas/all-sofas?sort=featured_asc, /mattresses-by-hipvan, /beds/bed-frames?sort=featured_asc -- these are the site's normal Sofas/Mattresses/Bed Frames category pages merely re-sorted by 'featured', not a standalone Bestsellers merchandising concept page, so excluded per the PDP/sort-variant exclusion rule. A 'Trending' homepage section also exists in the page template markup but is wrapped in an HTML comment (<!-- ... c-home__trending ... -->), i.e. present in code but not live/rendered. One promotional banner image asset is filenamed '...bestsellers-v5.png' but its actual click-through link (https://www.hipvan.com/better-at-home-sale) 404s -- an expired campaign, unrelated to any live Bestsellers listing. Conclusion: correct absence, not a failure to find.
